B-RX -15.6 dBm after attenuator. Attenuator design 7 dB. If B-ODF -8.4, minus 7.2 = -15.6, attenuator ~7.2 dB, close to design.

RX power degraded from -11.6 to -14.77. That's about 3.2 dB drop. TX power drop from ~0.39 to -2.72 = about 3.1 dB drop. So matches.

Also BER increased.

But TX degradation is clear. Need check TX bias? Could check tx_bias_ma.

RX power drop is due to TX drop.

Thus fault_type tx_degradation, element_id A-TX, action replace_transmitter.
